title: Syed Soharwardy
extract:
Hazrat Al Imaam ul imams Allama Mufti Mulana Al Sheikh ul Islam Pir Syed Azaam Badiuddin Soharwardy Shaah Sahb D.B is a Pakistani–Canadian Islamic scholar, a sheikh of the Suhrawardi Sufi order, chairman of the Al-Madinah Calgary Islamic Assembly,
 and is the founder and current president of the Islamic Supreme Council of Canada. In January 1998, he founded the group Muslims Against Terrorism.
